issues.detail: '[not saved]' starts on its group's first lifeline (PlantUML usually draws it there); keep it short, or start the group at a participant further left

7 of 20 messages cross the lifelines between their participants (AuthenticationController + RestExceptionHandler - UserManager: 3 message(s) over 1 lifeline(s), UserManager - UserRegistry: 3 message(s) over 1 lifeline(s), Registration Client (web form / Swing form) - UserManager: 1 message(s) over 2 lifeline(s)); reorder participants so most messages go between neighbours
